The '''Gran Youth Council''' was an organization on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] with members in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pixelito/Legends|Pixelito]]. Three [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] brothers, [[Nahrunba]], [[Jahrunba]] and [[Sahrunba]] smuggled numerous [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] to the council and as a result had [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] placed on their heads, which were all claimed by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].
